qualification.details: Full-Time Teacher (Social Science): Graduation and 2 years Diploma in Elementary Education OR 50% marks in Graduation/Post-Graduation with B.Ed OR Graduation with 45% and 1 year B.Ed OR 12th pass with 50% and 4 years B.El.Ed OR Graduation with 50% and B.Ed (Special Education) AND CTET/TET qualified. Part Time Teacher (TGT/PGT): Post Graduate in respective subject with 50% marks and B.Ed OR Post Graduate with 50% marks and B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed. Physical Education Teacher: B.P.Ed with 50% marks OR M.P.Ed with 50% marks. Art Teacher: 12th pass with 2-years Diploma in Drawing/Painting/Fine Art OR Bachelor's Degree in Fine Art/Drawing & Painting/Commercial Art/Applied Art. Asst. Cook: 4th std. passed and experience in Cooking. Chowkidar: 10th std passed or has at least attempted SSC. Sweeper: 4th std passed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Samagra Shiksha DNH & DD Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ddd.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 19-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Samagra Shiksha DNH & DD recruitment is 19 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the department before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts is based on a Walk-in-Interview. Candidates must appear in person with their original documents for verification on the scheduled date of 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Are male candidates eligible to apply?
faq.answer: No, according to the official notification, all the mentioned posts are reserved exclusively for female candidates. Male candidates are not eligible to apply for these specific vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 30 years. Age relaxation is provided as per the guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts. Candidates can submit their applications without any payment.

faq.question: Q6. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to: Department of Education, Samagra Shiksha, Room No. 312, 3rd Floor, Lekha Bhavan, 66 KV Road, Amli, Silvassa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Full-Time Teacher post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Full-Time Teacher post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23,000/- as per the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these posts are purely on a short-term contract (STC) basis. The notification clearly states that these positions do not provide any right for regularization in the future.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply via email?
faq.answer: Yes, the notification allows for submission through Post, Courier, Email, or in person. However, ensure all self-attested documents are included regardless of the mode of submission.

faq.question: Q10. Is local preference given in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the official notification mentions that preference will be given to local candidates for these positions under the Samagra Shiksha DNH & DD recruitment drive.
